name: Nomura Miki
source:
She lives on the island. She is a member of the Boy Scouts' Peace Keeping Enforcer division who keeps public moral in check every day. 

She is also in-charge of the island's broadcasting tower. She monitors for public disorder from atop the tower itself.

Those who disturbs the public order shall be mercilessly shot with her self-purpose remodelled water pistol called,"Hydro Gladiator-Revised Version".
